## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1-3"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/navigation-menu/card-1.png" alt="Trigger: 1, 3" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><i class="odv-am-n">3</i><b>Trigger</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you act on it?">Affordance</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you hit it?">Reach</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · How large is body text? → Large</div><div class="odv-am-why">Large text is readable for more people.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Spacious</div><div class="odv-am-why">Space lowers effort and mis-taps.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For the smallest clickable thing, use size.control.default (large). Don't use touch-minimum size.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Large targets help people with motor needs.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.body.font-size</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.font-size</code><span class="odv-am-val">1.1875rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.size.19</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.label.font-weight</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.font-weight</code><span class="odv-am-val">700</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.weight.700</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>space.inset.container</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.padding-x</code><span class="odv-am-val">1.5rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.24</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x2</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.padding-y</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.8</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>space.gap.tight</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.icon-gap</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.75rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. <section class="odv-am-card" id="part-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/navigation-menu/card-2.png" alt="Open trigger: 2" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Open trigger</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → All, including loading</div><div class="odv-am-why">Every state, including loading, gets its own value.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.highlight</code><span>→</span><code>trigger.background.open</code><span class="odv-am-val">#EDEDED · dark #222222</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surface it sits on: darker in light, lighter in dark.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.100, one step lighter than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.50), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band on the menu and on cards.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.sunken, action.secondary.hover, category.5.subtle, disabled.surface. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.highlight.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-4-5"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/navigation-menu/card-3.png" alt="Panel surface and shadow: 4, 5" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">4</i><i class="odv-am-n">5</i><b>Panel surface and shadow</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What holds this?">Containment</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What sits on top?">Layering</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · What rises above the page? → Nothing</div><div class="odv-am-why">Flat is easier to read at high zoom.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · How soft are shadows? → No shadows</div><div class="odv-am-why">No shadows; borders do the work.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a menu or dialog, use A strong border and a dimmed page. Don't use a shadow only.</div><div class="odv-am-why">The dimmed page makes the dialog obvious.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.raised</code><span>→</span><code>viewport.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#FFFFFF · dark #141414</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Fills that float above content.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.0, the same as content (surface.default): a menu stands out by its edge alone, not by its fill.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.50, the same as content (surface.default): a menu stands out by its edge alone, not by its fill, as in light.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.default, action.secondary. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.raised.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.default</code><span>→</span><code>viewport.border</code><span class="odv-am-val">#D6D6D6 · dark #333333</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. ## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `navigation-menu`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy accessible-first navigation-menu`
